# agyn_init_script (Resource)

Manages an Agyn init script.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_init_script" "example" {
  agent_id    = agyn_agent.example.id
  description = "Initialize agent workspace."
  script      = <<-EOT
    echo "Preparing agent workspace"
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `script` (String) Init script content.

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Target agent identifier.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `mcp_id` (String) Target MCP identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the init script.
